flora: Thick carpet ferns (dense, lush fronds with highly repetitive rounded leaflets)
Fiddleheads (unfurling tightly wound spirals emerging from the base)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the rhythm of the repeating fronds; fiddleheads should look plump, smooth, and deliberately stylized; avoid wispy or fragile leaf stems; emphasize a heavy, ancient, and verdant undergrowth feel.

visual_logic.composition: A ground-level macro shot looking across a dense glade of lush ferns. A few prominent, oversized green fiddleheads form the focal point in the foreground, crisp against the soft-focus backdrop of the glade.
visual_logic.ground: Dark, damp charcoal clay earth peeking through a dense layer of vibrant green ground cover and decaying, moss-covered wood.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; sun-dappled forest light filtering down in sharp beams, illuminating the waxy transparency of the unfurling fiddleheads.
